trade_setups.title: Pin / Mean-Reversion Frame
trade_setups.thesis: Heavy positive gamma near spot can dampen movement and favor range behavior. Delta is currently supportive, which can reinforce pinning behavior around central strikes.
trade_setups.risk: Break and acceptance outside the pin zone can invalidate the range setup.
trade_setups.exact_trade: SPY 2026-09-18 Iron Condor: Buy 740 Put / Sell 750 Put / Sell 770 Call / Buy 780 Call (1-lot structure).

trade_setups.title: Upside Compression Toward Call Wall
trade_setups.thesis: Positive gamma above can attract price toward the next call concentration while compressing realized vol. Delta near spot is not strongly supportive, so upside follow-through may be less persistent.
trade_setups.risk: Failure back below the reclaimed wall can trap upside continuation entries.
trade_setups.exact_trade: SPY 2026-09-18 Call Debit Spread: Buy 800 Call / Sell 810 Call (1-lot structure).

trade_setups.title: Downside Expansion Through Put Wall
trade_setups.thesis: Negative gamma below can open a faster move toward the next downside pocket. Supportive delta can partially cushion downside acceleration unless the wall breaks decisively.
trade_setups.risk: Quick reclaim above the broken put wall can trigger short-covering and whipsaw.
trade_setups.exact_trade: SPY 2026-09-18 Put Debit Spread: Buy 745 Put / Sell 735 Put (1-lot structure).

trader_notes: Calls above 800 and puts below 745 define the nearest directional gates.
Spot is away from the gamma flip, so structural walls are the primary reference points.
Negative gamma dominates; directional breaks can extend quickly through weak liquidity pockets.
